background_image_description: A purple nebula dominates the center of the image, displaying a gradient of purple hues from lighter to darker tones. Wispy, cloud-like structures extend from the nebula's core. Numerous stars of varying brightness are scattered throughout the dark background. The nebula has a diffuse, uneven appearance.

nodes.asset_description: A yellow rectangle is centered on a black background. The rectangle is uniformly colored and positioned horizontally.

A black smartphone with a blank light blue screen is centered on a transparent background. The screen is vertically oriented and features no visible content. The phone has a black bezel and a small black camera lens at the top center.

A man with dark skin and dreadlocks sits cross-legged on the floor, wearing a light blue long-sleeved shirt and dark gray pants. He holds a light gray laptop on his lap and gives two thumbs up. Behind him is a transparent checkered background.
A horizontal white bar spans the width of the image against a black background. The bar is centered and positioned horizontally.

nodes.svg_description: A completely white image with no visible content.

nodes.asset_description: A yellow, circular emoji with a wide smile and white teeth is centered against a white background. Two red heart shapes are positioned over the eyes. The emoji casts a subtle shadow below.
A glossy red heart shape is centered on a transparent background. The heart is smooth and reflective, with subtle highlights along its edges.
A single white cloud is centered on a transparent background. The cloud has a soft, rounded shape with subtle shading and texture. The background consists of a grid of gray and white squares.
A yellow, round, cartoon face with wide white eyes and black pupils is centered on a transparent background. The mouth is open, revealing a red interior. Black eyebrows are positioned above the eyes.

A round, glossy blue button with a white arrow pointing to the right is centered on a white background. The arrow is positioned slightly off-center, curving from the top left to the bottom right. The button casts a soft shadow below it on the white surface.
